Marissa / Markus —

Opal (prospect) is asking for a fairly aggressive onboarding sweetener: 35% off list for 6 months + 3 months onboarding credits, two-region pilot. They want a commercial by EOD Tue. I've attached their SOW and a draft quote (opal-draft-quote-2028-04-01.xlsx).

My recommended compromise to keep the economics defensible: 22% off list for the first 3 months, then step down to 12% for months 4–12, plus a three-month onboarding credit capped at $30k applied to dedicated capacity usage. We require a 12-month committed term after POC and standard data residency language.

Why: Opal is a strategic integration target in mid-market health; if we lose them they may go to one of the hyperscalers. I think a managed sweetener gets us a reference and a productized VPC package.

Can we route this for an exception memo? Marcus — can you confirm the budget impact / EBITDA delta on the proposed compromise? Marissa — if this looks reasonable from salesops, can you prepare the exec memo template (one pager) with competitive context and recommended approval path?

Thanks,

Folks —

I ran the numbers on Stephanie's recommended compromise (22% then 12% stepdown + $30k onboarding credit). Impact summary:
- One-year revenue reduction vs list: ~$186k on expected POC consumption profile; assuming we convert to a 12-month committed term we recover ~65% of the delta over year two under conservative usage.
- Margin impact (post-variable infra, before fixed overhead): ~7 pts depending on utilization pattern — acceptable if Opal becomes a reference and we onboard other customers in the same vertical.

Risk controls I'd require before sign-off:
1) Signed 12 month post-POC commitment (min ARR floor)
2) Cap onboarding credit to direct setup labor + first-month GPU fees, not open-ended capacity credits (we can cap at $30k as suggested).
3) Non-refundable onboarding credit draw schedule tied to milestones (design kickoff, infra readiness, data ingest complete).

If the board-level retention is a hard requirement I'd recommend pushing to 24 months or increasing the stepdown to 8% after month 4.

Given the urgency, I think we can live at 22%/12% + $30k capped credits conditioned on the three controls above. That will need an exec-level sign-off (CFO). Markus — can you push this to the CFO with the memo? If Marcus (finance) approves as interim that's fine but I want explicit CFO confirmation for any >20% initial discount.

Marcus Lin
Head of Finance
Redwood Inference

Team —

Per our quick call with finance, I'm escalating to confirm final executive direction and capture the sign-off so we can return to Opal. Summary of approved commercial:

- Initial discount: 22% off list for the first 3 months.
- Stepdown: 12% for months 4–12.
- Onboarding credit: $30,000 cap applied to dedicated capacity billing; milestone-driven draw schedule (design kickoff / infra ready / data ingest complete).
- Commitment: Signed 12 month contract post-POC with minimum ARR floor to be defined in the commercial annex.
- Pilot region: single region (us-west) for the POC; dual-region optional as post-POC addendum.

Marcus (Head of Finance) has reviewed margin impact and recommended the conditions above. This message serves as exec-level endorsement to proceed with the concession under the stated controls. Stephanie — please update the quote and return to Sarah with the two-region language as an optional post-POC addendum.

-Markus
